traits.note: The Lucid key to the flowering plant families, with Plants of the World Online and a Smithsonian family text, as search results quote them (the pages themselves were not read): sepals 3 and petals 3, free or united; flowers regular, mostly bisexual (some unisexual and weakly zygomorphic); stamens 6; ovary of 3 fused carpels, 3-celled, superior to inferior, so its position is left to each genus (Hechtia's ranges from largely superior to largely inferior).
